newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil flat, mood bearish despite Singapore.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil flat, mood bearish despite Singapore.

text.p: European heavy fuel prices were little changed in dull trading on Tuesday morning.
Dealers said the market remains bearish despite broadly steady prices in Rotterdam where barges traded between $81 and $82.50 during the morning.
"You can see the weakness on cargoes," said a broker who pegged sellers of prompt no better than $81 but slightly under $80 for more flexible May sales.
"The key will be how Singapore holds up," said a refiner who noted May swaps were around $97 compared to $82.50 for Rotterdam barges.
Low sulphur remains depressed with little demand and sellers of early May barrels starting to fish for demand.
Sellers were notionally pegged around $90 fob although brokers said a lack of bids meant selling levels might dip below that level.
Italian demand remains muted with the most recent data showing a fall of 18 percent in demand for power generation compared to year ago levels.
